text: `Path.resolve_strict_relative()` is not a standard method in Python's `pathlib` - this appears to be a misunderstanding or confusion with other methods. The correct method is `Path.resolve()` which returns an absolute path with all symbolic links resolved, and `Path.relative_to()` which computes a relative path from one directory to another. Both methods are part of the standard `pathlib` module but don't have a `resolve_strict_relative` variant.
